about: Constructed for these labs on 24 Oct 2026: questions a customer might ask about support_handbook.md, each labelled with the policy files that answer it, from the policy text, before any search ran. 'customer words' questions share few words with their policy; 'rare term' questions use a word the policy uses. Not human annotations, not a benchmark.
